suppress.notes: CVE-2026-33117 applies to Azure Key Vault Keys in Azure SDK for Java. Dependency-check reports the Application Insights 2.6.4 artifacts through a low-confidence azure_sdk_for_java CPE match, but these artifacts do not contain the vulnerable key-vault library.
CVE-2026-54285 affects the JavaScript package @opentelemetry/core before 2.8.0. These are OpenTelemetry Java API artifacts and do not contain the affected JavaScript code.

Spring Framework 6.2.20 is available only under enterprise support. The application does not use the affected XSLT or FreeMarker views, functional MVC/WebFlux, WebFlux multipart, Aalto XML, RSocket, Jetty WebFlux cookies, WebFlux WebSockets, UrlHandlerFilter, UrlFileNameViewController, SSE view fragments, compiled SimpleEvaluationContext expressions, user-supplied SpEL, HTML-rendered binding errors, or untrusted Content-Disposition filenames. The application is a Spring MVC JSON API and the repository contains no use of those APIs.

Spring Security 6.5.12 is available only under enterprise support. This service does not use embedded UnboundID LDAP, WebAuthn, AesBytesEncryptor, DigestAuthenticationFilter, KeyBasedPersistenceTokenService, Password4j encoders, or InMemoryOAuth2AuthorizationService.

Spring Security 6.5.12 is available only under enterprise support. CVE-2026-41707 affects DPoPProofJwtDecoderFactory's replay cache. This service uses NimbusJwtDecoder for bearer JWT validation and does not use DPoPProofJwtDecoderFactory or DPoP proof-of-possession tokens.

Spring Cloud Commons 4.3.4 is available only under enterprise support. CVE-2026-59284 requires the writable actuator env endpoint. This service exposes only health and info actuator endpoints, so the vulnerable endpoint is neither exposed nor writable.

Spring Data JPA 3.5.14 is available only under enterprise support. CVE-2026-47834 requires an untrusted Sort or Pageable parameter on a native repository query. The application's only native Spring Data repository query has no Sort or Pageable parameter.
